title: Biology practice
subject: biology
source: Written by the Magana team in the style of WAEC SSCE Biology. Not past questions. CC BY 4.0.
review: Sample: to be reviewed by a Biology teacher before testing with learners.

questions.question: Which reagent is used to test for starch?
questions.explanation: Iodine solution turns blue-black when starch is present.

questions.question: In which part of the cell does aerobic respiration mainly take place?
questions.explanation: The mitochondrion releases energy from food during aerobic respiration.

questions.question: Which blood vessel carries blood from the lungs to the heart?
questions.explanation: The pulmonary vein carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium.

questions.question: What is the process by which green plants make their own food using light energy?
questions.explanation: In photosynthesis, chlorophyll traps light energy to make glucose from carbon dioxide and water.

questions.question: Which organism carries the malaria parasite from person to person?
questions.explanation: The female Anopheles mosquito carries Plasmodium, the parasite that causes malaria.

questions.question: Which part of a flower produces pollen grains?
questions.explanation: Pollen grains are made in the anther, at the top of the stamen.

questions.question: The movement of water molecules from a dilute solution to a concentrated solution through a semi-permeable membrane is called what?
questions.explanation: Osmosis is the movement of water across a semi-permeable membrane, from a dilute to a more concentrated solution.

questions.question: Lack of which vitamin causes scurvy?
questions.explanation: Scurvy, with bleeding gums, is caused by lack of vitamin C, found in oranges and fresh vegetables.

questions.question: Which organ produces bile?
questions.explanation: Bile is made in the liver and stored in the gall bladder.

questions.question: Two plants that are both heterozygous for tallness are crossed. Tall is dominant. What ratio of tall to short offspring is expected?
questions.explanation: Crossing Tt with Tt gives TT, Tt, Tt and tt: three tall to one short.
